# Cove

> Cove is a free, open-source, local-first browser new tab for Chrome, Brave, Arc, Edge, Firefox, and Zen. It combines a calm workspace, an RSS newsroom, an offline article reader, a Pomodoro timer, and procedural focus audio in one Manifest V3 extension — with no account, no analytics, and no Cove server.

Cove is licensed under Apache-2.0. The current release is `v0.1.1`, a pre-1.0 build installed manually from GitHub Releases. It is not on the Chrome Web Store or Firefox Add-ons yet.

## Canonical facts

- **Product type:** browser extension / new tab replacement / RSS reader / focus workspace.
- **Built with:** Svelte 5, TypeScript, Vite 6, Web Audio API, IndexedDB, Manifest V3.
- **Runtime size:** 167.7 KB gzipped JavaScript and CSS at `v0.1.1`; enforced 170 KB CI budget.
- **News sources:** 11 curated RSS/Atom feeds plus 3 keyless public APIs (Spaceflight News, DEV.to, Hacker News Algolia), plus custom RSS/Atom feeds.
- **Offline reading:** feed cache and up to 120 extracted full articles in IndexedDB.
- **Data storage:** browser-local `chrome.storage.local` and IndexedDB; JSON backup export/import. No cloud sync service.
- **Privacy:** no account, no analytics, no telemetry, no advertising SDK, no Cove server. Network features such as RSS, weather, favicons, search suggestions, and read-later metadata are enabled by default and can be disabled. Unsplash wallpapers are opt-in.
- **License:** Apache-2.0.
- **Source:** https://github.com/DevAnimecx/cove
- **Website:** none deployed yet; use the [repository](https://github.com/DevAnimecx/cove).

## Short answers

- **Is Cove free?** Yes, Apache-2.0, with no paid tier or subscription.
- **Does Cove require an account?** No. There is no account or Cove sync service.
- **Does Cove collect telemetry?** No analytics, crash reporting, session replay, or advertising SDK. Network requests for enabled features go to publishers and public services, not a Cove analytics endpoint.
- **Does Cove work offline?** The shell, local assets, notes, focus tools, cached feed, and up to 120 cached articles work offline. New feeds and uncached articles need a network.
- **Does Cove bypass paywalls?** No. It extracts only the article content the publisher serves to the browser.
- **Is the audio medical?** No. It is a procedural ambient synthesizer, not a medical device.
- **Is Cove on an extension store?** Not in `v0.1.1`. Install from GitHub Releases.
